title: Kamza Basket win Division 1 title
description: Kamza Basket have won Division 1 title as they finished on top undefeated. In the last game they edged Dinamo 88-79. The latter finished second, while Elbasani is third. Elbasani overcame Apolonia 85-73, whilst Apolonia edged Flamurtari 55-48 in the latest game. Flamurtari managed to win only one game in the League.
imageCaption: Kamza Basket win Division 1 title (Photo: Facebook)
